children: Industrial production in Lithuania rose 4.8% year-on-year in August 2026, accelerating from 3.3% in the previous month.
Growth picked up in manufacturing, reaching 5.2% from 3.6% in July, and in mining and quarrying activity, rising to 9.5% from 3.2%.
The pace of decline also eased in water supply, sewerage, waste management, and remediation services, with activity falling 10.1% compared with a 12.3% contraction in July.
Meanwhile, the downturn deepened in electricity, gas, steam, and air conditioning supply, where activity declined 6.1% after a 4.3% fall in the previous month.
On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial production rose 0.2%, recovering from a revised 2.7% drop in July.

title: Lithuania Industrial Output Rises Further in August
